message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top discard. 3. If you have no playable card, you must draw from the draw pile. If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **House Rules (optional)** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No Challenge** – ignore the challenge rule for Wild Draw Four.
• **Custom Decks** – use themed decks or add extra cards. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a balanced hand** – try to hold a mix of colors and numbers so you’re not stuck with only one color. 2. **Watch the discard pile** – if you see a lot of a particular color, you might want to play that color early. 3. **Use Wild cards strategically** – save them for when you’re about to run out of playable cards or to force a color change that benefits you. 4. **Challenge wisely** – only challenge if you’re sure the previous player had a playable card; otherwise, you’ll pay the penalty. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
